ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the measures being taken to prevent it.
questions: What is the total amount of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What measures are being taken to prevent Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and highlight the need for increased oversight and monitoring of Medicaid programs.
